==Usage==
Place <nowiki>{{Expand|this page needs expanding on [sections]}}</nowiki> on articles that need to have parts or sections of them expanded upon by editors, or make a new section on the article's talk page to elaborate on the changes needed. Make sure to replace [sections] with the relevant sections of the article. Not to be confused with [[Template:Update]] (intended for articles lacking content from a new source) or [[Template:Stub]] (intended for articles lacking sections).

Per [[Forum:CT:Fixing the Expand template]], all additions of this template require a reason either in the template or on the talk page.
